supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49:57 UTC, FILE-SUN-01 (10.55.20.20) sent 640,000,484 bytes to the explicit proxy (10.55.20.30:8080) over a 12-second connection, consistent with the alerted large transfer.

The transfer size is compatible with the organization's description of the approved Arcvault backup upload, which sends several hundred MB, but the available record does not identify the application or destination behind the proxy.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection status reports a FILE-SUN-01 winsec and Sysmon outage from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, so process execution and host-side attribution around the transfer are unavailable.
The supplied collection status reports a proxy-log outage from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, preventing identification of the proxy destination, request, or associated user.
Zeek connection telemetry records the large transfer to the proxy, not the ultimate external destination or the transfer contents.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer went to the approved Arcvault backup service or an unapproved destination.
Which process or account initiated the transfer and whether it was the approved backup agent.
What data was transferred, whether it was authorized, or whether it contained sensitive information.
Whether the transfer was malicious or simply the expected backup activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs or upstream egress records for the 13:49:57 UTC transfer to identify its ultimate destination and request details.
Obtain FILE-SUN-01 process, service, and Arcvault agent logs for the transfer time to confirm the initiating process and job.
Review backup-job records and transfer manifests for a corresponding scheduled or completed Arcvault upload.
Correlate the transfer with FILE-SUN-01 RDP session and authentication records once the missing host telemetry is available.
unrelated_findings: WS-LWARD-01 ran mstsc.exe to connect to FILE-SUN-01 at 13:43:35 UTC, and Zeek recorded an RDP session lasting about 31 minutes. This is outside the documented remote-administration practice; the available records do not establish that the session caused the alerted transfer. Records: T230-00272, T230-00281, T230-00282.

A Kerberos service-ticket event for svc-store records the source IP as 45.79.19.196 at 13:49:01 UTC. Investigate the external source and account use separately; the records do not link it to the proxy transfer. Record: T230-00341.

FILE-SUN-01 established a TLS connection to WS-ZADAMS-01 on port 443 shortly before the transfer. Its purpose and relationship, if any, to the alert are not established. Records: T230-00306, T230-00308.

WS-MFISCHER-01 recorded taskhostw.exe using explicit credentials for svc-ledger against FILE-SUN-01 at 14:05:42 UTC, although the inventory describes the LedgerSync job as running on FILE-SUN-01. Investigate separately. Record: T230-00437.
